audit_items.proof_trace: Individual per-investor token allocations are computed entirely off-chain and committed to `claimTokensMerkleRoot`; `claimTokenAllocation` consumes the Merkle-verified amount directly without any on-chain division. The sole on-chain formula `(tokensAllocated * tokenPrice) / 10^askTokenDecimals` in `publishSaleResults` correctly multiplies before dividing (minimising truncation), is overflow-safe under Solidity 0.8.30, and any truncation (bounded by `tokenPrice - 1` bid-wei) only reduces the project team's withdrawable capital while excess remains locked for investor withdrawals.
